title: The Goat in the Boat
lines: Cole had a goat with a black coat.
Dad and Cole got in a small red boat.
The goat got in the boat with them.
A crow came to sit on the back.
The goat got up to snap at the crow.
The boat tipped on its side.
Dad held Cole as the goat fell in!
Cole had to throw a rope to it.
The rope fell short, and the goat swam on.
Then Cole held up the bag of corn.
The wet goat swam slow back to the boat.
Dad got it in, and Cole held it close.

questions.ask: Why did the boat go on its side?
questions.listenFor: The goat got up to snap at the crow. Two steps - let them find both.

questions.ask: What got the goat to swim back to the boat?
questions.listenFor: Cole held up the bag of corn. The rope had fallen short of the goat.

questions.ask: What do you think Cole will take the next time they go out in the boat?
questions.listenFor: Any guess with a reason. The bag of corn is what got the goat back, in lines ten and eleven.
